map.name: Tarrow Crossing
map.setting: a crossroads inn and its hamlet
map.trouble: Gorbash and his Ogres hold Fort Grimmock and have shut the east road, and their raiders rob the wagons that come through the crossroads.

guard_bark.specifics: Thurl at the east gate of Tarrow Crossing, shut while Gorbash's Ogres hold Fort Grimmock.

first.speaker: Thurl
first.text: Hurry! Mayor Pellam is waiting for you upstairs in the Town Hall. There's a ladder behind the clerk's desk that will take you right up to him.

again.speaker: Thurl
again.text: We must hold this gate and make the Ogres pay for every wagon they've burned!

later.speaker: Thurl
later.text: Those big ugly Ogres and their drums used to keep me up all night.

bounty_offer.specifics: Ottmar, a stubborn pig farmer, loses his pigs to the Bears of Thistle Wood.

offer.speaker: Ottmar
offer.text: No matter if the Bears carry off every last pig! This farm is all I have. Even a Grizzly wouldn't dare trespass on the land of an honest man! But if you clear out their den in Thistle Wood, I'll reward you well.

reminder.speaker: Ottmar
reminder.text: Thanks for stopping by. Now go get those Bears.

completion.speaker: Ottmar
completion.text: Thank you for killing those Bears. Here, take this shield.

journal.text: Locate the Bear den in Thistle Wood.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Marga, an old woman of the hamlet; the Imps of the old windmill stole her amulet.

offer.speaker: Marga
offer.text: Search the old windmill from top to bottom if you have to. If you want a torch or a rope, you can take the ones hanging by my door. The windmill is just up the west road. Will you bring my amulet back from those Imps?

refusal.speaker: Marga
refusal.text: Fine, don't help an old woman. I'm doomed.

reminder.speaker: Marga
reminder.text: Hail Bodrick, one more hero off to fight the Imps.

completion.speaker: Marga
completion.text: Wonderful, my amulet. Here, have a couple of these.

after.speaker: Marga
after.text:
Thanks again for your trouble! All of Tarrow Crossing will hear about your courage!

Bless you for your kindness!

journal.text: Fight your way into the old windmill and recover Marga's amulet from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Fight your way into the old windmill and recover Marga's amulet from the Imps.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk of Tarrow Crossing: Fenna, Pimm and Jory.

rumour1.speaker: Fenna
rumour1.text: Hello young sir! Come find me after you've beaten the Ogres.

rumour2.speaker: Pimm
rumour2.text: Shouldn't you be off to Fort Grimmock by now?

rumour3.speaker: Jory
rumour3.text: Don't give up hope now, stranger, those Ogres will run from our pitchforks!

shop_greeting.specifics: Bodrick of the Copper Kettle inn, Gundar the smith, Grizelda of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Bodrick
inn.text: I hear Gorbash's Ogres are coming down out of the hills. Might be time for me to sell the Copper Kettle and move on.

arms.speaker: Gundar
arms.text: Watch your back on the east road, lad! I've got shields here big enough for two of you.

magic.speaker: Grizelda
magic.text: Word gets around. Get out, before I turn you into a toad!

two_givers.specifics: Hobart, a caravan master, wants the crates the Ogres took from his wagons; Fitch, a peddler at the Copper Kettle, sells a pair of boots for 80 gold.

offer_a.speaker: Hobart
offer_a.text: Ogres robbed two of my wagons on the east road and one more near the old bridge. After you find the crates from the first two I'll send my drivers out after the third. I'll stay here and keep an eye on the crossroads. Find my crates and haul them back here.

offer_b.speaker: Fitch
offer_b.text:
Ah, here they are... the finest boots this side of the mountains. My uncle pulled them off a dead Ogre, back when the fort was still ours. They'll serve you well against whatever's waiting for you out on the east road.

Yours for 80 gold.

outcome_a.speaker: Hobart
outcome_a.text: That settles our business, stranger. Take this Longsword for your trouble, and mind what I told you about the old bridge.

outcome_b.speaker: Fitch
outcome_b.text: Congratulations, stranger! You are now the proud owner of the finest boots in all the land!

journal_a.text: Retrieve Hobart's crates from the Ogre raiders

journal_b.text: Find enough gold to buy Fitch's boots.

rescue.specifics: Dorlise, wife of Gundar the smith, sent her boy Corby to hide in the old mine, where the Spiders nest.

plea.speaker: Dorlise
plea.text:
Ah, there you are. This is the blackest day in all of Tarrow -- my boy Corby is missing!

I sent him to hide in the old mine in case the Ogres came through the crossroads. That mine will prove his doom should he wander into the Spiders' nest. Please, bring him home!

reminder.speaker: Dorlise
reminder.text: Hmmm... don't say a word to his father. I'll try to keep him busy at the forge.

following.speaker: Corby
following.text: No matter if the Spiders come after us! The tunnel goes up to the light. Even Spiders won't follow us out into the sun!

completion.speaker: Dorlise
completion.text: My Corby has been found and brought home safe and sound! Please, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Search the old mine and bring Corby home.

main_opening.specifics: Pimm points the player, sent by Vardis, to Mayor Pellam in the Town Hall, who sends him against Gorbash in Fort Grimmock.

herald.speaker: Pimm
herald.text: So you're the one Vardis sent! Welcome to Tarrow Crossing! As keepers of the crossroads, we see all manner of trouble. I'm sure you'll find Mayor Pellam in the Town Hall, he's expecting you.

opening.speaker: Pellam
opening.text:
I've never been inside Fort Grimmock and can only give this to you this warning as it was told to me, long ago -- beware of the Troll.

Gorbash and his Ogres must be driven out of that fort, lad, or the east road stays shut for good.

reminder.speaker: Pellam
reminder.text: The Ogres at the front gate let nobody by, lad. But find the old drain under the north wall and you're inside!

journal.text: Enter Fort Grimmock and defeat Gorbash.
